surfaces: signs, labels, subtitles, notices, and instructions
Discord, dashboard, media, and catch-up copy that players encounter
investigation objectives, filing affordances, and submission feedback

human_quality_rule: Static inventory and diversity evidence support review but cannot convert writing, room composition, or puzzle legibility into a quota; human review remains mandatory, and believable language must never be misread as a requirement for simple, obvious, short, or easy investigation.

progression_and_evidence_interaction_sta.substantial_content_requirement: Content must be materially necessary for fair deduction, synthesis, callbacks, and later understanding rather than enforced by click-completion quotas.
required_negative_tests: correct report succeeds with zero observation receipts
correct synthesis succeeds on the zero-observation correct path
wrong report fails regardless of observation receipt count
observation provenance, contribution credit, replay, and catch-up remain durable and non-gating

copy_standard.format_selection_rule: Each form must be plausible for its author, recipient, workplace, placement, and evidentiary job; different containers may not disguise duplicated prose.
copy_standard.voice_selection_rule: Artifacts must differ where the fiction supplies different knowledge, motive, relationship, register, or reliability; diversity is qualitative rather than a minimum count.

static_checks.predicate: every inventoried room declares a specific ordinary institutional job supported by its compositions
every room's dimensions and negative space have a functional rationale tied to circulation, work, storage, or civic use
every lectern has an artifact-specific natural purpose and rooms do not read as repeated lectern stations
repeated fixtures are fictionally justified, purpose-classified, and compositionally varied
every artifact declares plausible format, placement, provenance, canon references, and medium fit
the selected artifacts demonstrate situated human voices and evidence roles without treating a minimum count as quality
player-facing text contains no chat tutorial scaffolding, handholding labels, or puzzle-setter address
duplicate text hashes, repeated templates, and medium-inappropriate exposition are rejected rather than counted as variety
a recorded cold human review proves workplace, objective, artifact, interaction, and deduction comprehension before visual review
every selectable native-book option passes exact pagination and supported-client render budgets and remains fully visible and clickable
every stair chair faces a believable seated use within its furniture composition and no chair faces a wall without an authored workstation purpose
every interactive evidence block visibly communicates its affordance; chiseled bookshelves expose occupied slots or are replaced
difficulty derives from investigation, synthesis, recall, provenance, spatial observation, or callbacks rather than UI friction or opaque controls
a supported non-op client completes the full intended path and proves every choice, filing, synthesis, replay, and protection interaction renders and operates correctly
distributed or multi-layered evidence preserves any-subset, replay, accessibility, catch-up, and no-missable guarantees
an exact correct answer, report, and synthesis are accepted with zero observed-source interaction receipts
observation receipts retain provenance, contribution, replay, catch-up, hint, changed-place, accessibility, and director value but never gate correct-answer acceptance

cold_read_criteria: cold player can state the room's ordinary institutional job
cold player can state the disputed civic question without external explanation
cold player distinguishes readable evidence from conclusion filing
cold player explains why each sampled artifact plausibly exists in its placement
cold player recognizes materially different human voices and artifact formats
cold player identifies how a defensible finding would be filed without being expected to solve it under review time pressure
cold player explains that four findings combine into the final synthesis
naive touching of every surface commits no unsupported finding and leaves the gate closed
cold player navigates public and staff circulation without chat or tutorial labels
cold player describes the space as a believable workplace or civic facility rather than a puzzle chamber or room of lecterns
observer judges prose plausible for its stated human author, relationship, workplace, and medium
observer records every moment that required out-of-world explanation
cold player identifies readable evidence surfaces from visible physical affordance rather than trial-clicking empty-looking blocks
every selectable book option is fully visible and clickable at the supported client UI
seating and furniture facing communicate believable work, waiting, or conversation use
cold player may submit a correct shared or externally known conclusion without touching its source surfaces
guided_client_criteria: every four-choice question displays all choices without overflow or hidden correct answers
every displayed choice can be selected through the intended native client UI
the complete correct report and final synthesis can be submitted without console, operator, or out-of-world workarounds
interactive evidence surfaces have an unmistakable visible physical affordance
full path replay, protection, accessibility, and catch-up behavior is exercised by a supported non-op Adventure client
the exact correct report and synthesis complete with zero observation receipts while wrong reports still fail

preserve: exact directional block states and support fixes
local-primary persistence, restart, replay, protection, and idempotency
locked spine and approved evidence model
required: functionally justified room scale and furnishing density
distinct natural record-reading and finding-filing affordances
